description: Status, progress and, once completed, the result of long-running calls (media.import, media.analyze, create.*, export.video, qa.check). Same record as tasks/get. status_message says what it is doing, or, while it waits, where it stands in the queue and what it waits for. It answers at once with where each job stands. job_id reads one job; job_ids reads many in one call and answers {jobs, not_found}.
